text: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.
When Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are closed.
Fasting is a shield; so when one of you is fasting, let him not speak obscenely or act ignorantly.
There is a gate in Paradise called Ar-Rayyan, through which only those who fast will enter.
Whoever gives iftar to a fasting person will have the same reward without reducing theirs.
When My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
Recite the Quran, for on the Day of Resurrection it will come as an intercessor for its companions.
Allah said: Every action of the son of Adam is for him except fasting, for it is for Me and I shall reward it.
Whoever does not give up false speech and acting upon it, Allah has no need of his giving up his food and drink.
Seek Laylatul Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan.
Whoever gives charity equal to a date from good earnings, Allah accepts it and grows it until it becomes like a mountain.
Whoever stands in prayer on Laylatul Qadr out of faith and seeking reward, his past sins will be forgiven.
The Prophet ﷺ was the most generous in Ramadan when Jibreel would meet him.
Fasting the month of patience (Ramadan) and three days of every month is fasting for a lifetime.
When the last ten days began, the Prophet ﷺ would tighten his waist belt, stay up the night in worship and wake his family.
Take to fasting, for there is nothing like it.
The breath of a fasting person is sweeter to Allah than the scent of musk.
Whoever prays qiyam in Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, his past sins will be forgiven.
When you make dua, do not say 'if You wish'; ask with firm resolve, for nothing is too great for Allah to give.
The strong is not the one who overcomes people, but who controls himself when angry.
Laylatul Qadr is better than a thousand months.
By his good character, a believer attains the rank of one who fasts by day and prays at night.
Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul 'afwa fa'fu 'anni — O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
The one who recites Quran skillfully is with the noble scribes (angels).
Allah extends His hand at night to accept repentance of those who sinned by day.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
Nothing is heavier on the Scale than good character.
The best of you are those who are best to their families.
Charity does not decrease wealth.
Whoever fasts Ramadan then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted forever.
